content.user_title: Create and Edit AI Music with RunComfy
content.value_statement: Choosing a suitable music model and request format can require detailed platform knowledge. This skill routes each request and prepares the correct RunComfy workflow.
actual_capabilities: Routes generation requests by quality, price, language, and vocal requirements.
Prepares ElevenLabs Music prompts with style, lyrics, and section markers.
Prepares ACE Step tags, lyrics, durations, and model selections.
Repairs time-bounded sections through ACE Step audio inpainting.
Extends tracks before or after existing audio through ACE Step outpainting.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, authentication, and access to supported remote models.
Generation uses paid services, and listed prices may change.
Audio editing requires a user-provided URL that the model service can access.
The skill does not verify lyric rights, commercial licenses, or output originality.

use_cases.title: Produce a Campaign Track
use_cases.description: Select a premium model and structure a polished vocal or instrumental brief for a campaign.

use_cases.title: Build Affordable Music Libraries
use_cases.description: Create varied background tracks and loops with cost-sensitive ACE Step settings.

use_cases.title: Repair or Extend Existing Audio
use_cases.description: Replace a timed section or add an intro and outro without rebuilding the full track.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Instrumental
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 60-second instrumental track for [purpose]. Use [genre], [mood], [tempo], and [instruments]. Choose a cost-effective model.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Vocal Song
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [duration] song in [language] with [genre] styling, [vocal type], and these lyrics: [lyrics]. Include clear verse and chorus sections.

prompt_templates.title: Repair a Song Section
prompt_templates.prompt: Replace the section from [start time] to [end time] in [audio URL]. Match [style details] and use [lyrics or instrumental direction].

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Draft-to-Premium Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Develop [number] low-cost drafts for [brief], compare their musical direction, then prepare one premium [duration] final track within a budget of [amount].
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced model routing and budget planning

output_examples.input: Create a low-cost, 60-second instrumental loop for a calm puzzle game.
output_examples.output: Recommended route: ACE Step base. The prepared brief uses ambient electronic tags, a steady low-intensity groove, seamless-loop direction, and no lyrics.

output_examples.input: Extend my 30-second hook with a 20-second intro and a 40-second outro.
output_examples.output: Recommended route: ACE Step audio-outpaint. The request preserves the source hook while adding both requested sections in one generation call.

output_examples.input: Write a polished 45-second Spanish pop jingle with a strong chorus.
output_examples.output: Recommended route: ElevenLabs Music for premium polish, with ACE Step 1.5 as a lower-cost multilingual alternative. The brief includes Spanish lyrics and section markers.

best_practices: State the intended use, duration, language, vocal needs, quality target, and budget.
Draft short versions before paying for longer premium renders.
Use only audio and lyrics that you are authorized to submit and transform.
anti_patterns: Do not submit API tokens, private credentials, or confidential text as prompt content.
Do not request audio editing without exact time boundaries or extension lengths.
Do not assume generated music is automatically cleared for every commercial use.

faq.question: Which music models does this skill use?
faq.answer: It routes requests to ElevenLabs Music, ACE Step, ACE Step 1.5, and ACE Step editing endpoints.

faq.question: Can it create instrumental music?
faq.answer: Yes. It can prepare instrumental requests for songs, background tracks, jingles, and game loops.

faq.question: Can it generate multilingual vocals?
faq.answer: Yes. ACE Step 1.5 is the primary route for broad multilingual vocal support.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing track?
faq.answer: Yes. Audio inpainting replaces a timed section, while audio outpainting adds material before or after a track.

faq.question: Does it require authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. The RunComfy CLI requires an authenticated account or a configured RUNCOMFY_TOKEN.

faq.question: Does the skill guarantee music licensing rights?
faq.answer: No. Users must review model terms and confirm their rights to submitted lyrics, audio, and generated outputs.
